unclear.text: Resale before the coverage deadline (reg. 14 with reg. 9(3)).
readings: U1-a: transfers are allowed at any time with the Authority's consent (reg. 14); reg. 9(3) only states the purpose of the obligation
U1-b: reg. 9(3) bars any transfer until the obligation is met or the deadline passes

a1.text: Some blocks are bid at or above the reserve: bidders expect a license to be worth more than M40 million after the build-out cost.

a3.text: The obligation is enforced: revocation is credible, so licensees build to 90% by the end of 2032.

a5.text: Some bidders or holders use stakes or joint ventures below the affiliate line.

a8.text: Licensees would not, on their own, cover 90% of the population with the band by 2032 (about 65% commercially).

a9.text: Some licensees overstate coverage, meet it by minimal sites, or miss the deadline.

a11.text: Under U1-b, sales of licensee companies or long capacity leases are not treated as transfers.

a28.text: Investors expected the award partly from the March 2026 consultation and fully from 1 March 2027.

j1.text: Households and businesses outside the cities and large towns value mobile coverage in the band.

j2.text: Some bidders would take more than two blocks if the cap allowed it.

j3.text: Under U1-b, the Authority enforces the bar on transfers before the coverage deadline.

j4.text: Licensees expect each license to end on 31 December 2042 unless the Authority renews or re-auctions it.
